statement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer target.
Find every quadruplet of values taken from four different indices of nums whose sum equals target.
Return each distinct quadruplet once. Two quadruplets with the same four values count as one.

examples.explanation: Three distinct combinations of values add up to 0: -2 − 1 + 1 + 2, -2 + 0 + 0 + 2 and -1 + 0 + 0 + 1.
-3 − 3 − 3 + 3 = -6. The many copies of -3 and 3 all give that same quadruplet, so it is listed once.
